newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy offers 14 trln lire of BOTs for sale.
newsitem.headline: Italy offers 14 trln lire of BOTs for sale.

text.p: The Italian treasury said it was offering 14.0 trillion lire of short term bills (BOT), replacing 16.5 trillion lire of expiring paper.
A Treasury statement said it would offer:
Subscriptions close at 1200 GMT on February 11.
The Treasury added that it would offer two trillion lire of 18-month zero couponed certificates (CTZ) and 2.5 trillion lire of 24-month CTZ.
Subscriptions for both those sales also close at 1200 GMT, February 11.
The Treasury also said it was re-opening a 30-year bond, with an unchanged 7.25 percent coupon. The quantity on offer will be notified on February 10.
